title: All Is Vanity

questions.question: Who are the words of Ecclesiastes attributed to?
options: The Preacher, the son of David
questions.correctAnswer: The Preacher, the son of David
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:1 (ESV): "The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem."

questions.question: What is the main theme introduced in the first chapter?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:2 (ESV): "Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities! All is vanity."

questions.question: What does the Preacher say about the earth?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:4 (ESV): "A generation goes, and a generation comes, but the earth remains forever."

questions.question: What is the eye never satisfied with?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:8 (ESV): "the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing."

questions.question: Is there anything strictly new under the sun?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:9 (ESV): "What has been is what will be, and what has been done is what will be done, and there is nothing new under the sun."

questions.question: What happens to the remembrance of former things?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:11 (ESV): "There is no remembrance of former things,"

questions.question: What did the Preacher apply his heart to seek out?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:13 (ESV): "And I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom all that is done under heaven."

questions.question: What is a "striving after wind" according to the Preacher?
options: All deeds done under the sun
questions.correctAnswer: All deeds done under the sun
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:14 (ESV): "I have seen everything that is done under the sun, and behold, all is vanity and a striving after wind."

questions.question: What cannot be made straight?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:15 (ESV): "What is crooked cannot be made straight,"

questions.question: With much wisdom comes much what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:18 (ESV): "For in much wisdom is much vexation,"

questions.question: The sun rises, and the sun goes down, and hastens to where?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:5 (ESV): "and hastens to the place where it rises."

questions.question: All streams run to the sea, but the sea is not what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:7 (ESV): "All streams run to the sea, but the sea is not full;"

questions.question: What is an unhappy business that God has given to the children of man?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:13 (ESV): "It is an unhappy business that God has given to the children of man to be busy with."

questions.question: I said in my heart, "I have acquired great..." what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:16 (ESV): "I said in my heart, 'I have acquired great wisdom, surpassing all who were over Jerusalem before me,'"

questions.question: He who increases knowledge increases what?
questions.explanation: Ecclesiastes 1:18 (ESV): "and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow."

key_verse_text: Vanity of vanities, says the Preacher, vanity of vanities! All is vanity.
